backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles and full CRUD logic for categories, vendors, banks, expenses, revenue, and COGS with authorization and date-sorting helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing report‑related enhancements, their affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collected summaries of key frontend files describing functionality for routing, pages, components, hooks, and styling across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and global element rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point providing root container and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router, authentication flow, profile setup gating, and routes for all pages.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout shell with header navigation, logout handling, main content container, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/KpiCard.tsx: Reusable KPI card component displaying formatted values with variant-based coloring and icons.
frontend/src/components/NumericCell.tsx: Table cell component formatting numbers as currency, percent, or numeric with right-aligned monospace text.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Form dialog that collects a user's name and saves it via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/reports/MonthYea: Component providing month and year dropdowns for selecting a single period.
frontend/src/components/reports/MultiMon: Selector for choosing a start month/year and displaying the calculated multi‑month range.
frontend/src/components/reports/YearSele: Simple year dropdown selector using a sliding 10‑year window.
frontend/src/components/TimeWindowSelect: Select dropdown for choosing predefined time windows like day or month ranges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, categories, and other backend data with auto‑seeding and mutation support.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus theme variables, dark mode, utility classes, and print styling.
frontend/src/lib/constants/paymentMethod: Defines the fixed list of allowed restaurant payment methods.
frontend/src/lib/reports/dateRanges.ts: Provides helpers to compute date ranges for days, months, multi‑month periods, and years, plus formatting and end-month calculation.
frontend/src/lib/seed/restaurantCategori: Defines the default restaurant expense categories and seed version/constants.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function to merge and normalize class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that sets up React, query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsItemsTab.tsx: Manages inventory items, showing a table with add/edit functionality and vendor lookups.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsPurchasesTab: Shows purchase records with item/vendor references and supports adding or editing purchases.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSalesTab.tsx: Displays sales records tied to inventory items with dialogs for adding or editing sales.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSummaryTab.t: Calculates and displays COGS totals and trends over a selectable time range with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/utils.ts: Utility functions for COGS pages including date/timestamp conversions and bucket formatting.
frontend/src/pages/CogsPage.tsx: Renders the COGS section with tabbed navigation for items, purchases, sales, and summary views.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays financial KPIs and quick stats with selectable time windows using dashboard query data.
frontend/src/pages/ExpensesPage.tsx: Manages expense records with loading states, filtering data sources, and a dialog for creating or editing expenses.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides a simple login screen using Internet Identity with a sign‑in button and loading state.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Container page for managing categories, vendors, banks, and payment methods through tabbed CRUD interfaces.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Generates filtered financial reports based on selected date ranges, categories, and payment/bank filters using expense, revenue, and COGS data.
frontend/src/pages/RevenuePage.tsx: Displays revenue records with add/edit dialogs and loads categories and revenue entries from hooks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining custom colors, themes, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, known issues, and new requests related to multi‑month report range selection.
